key: Ho, traveler! I see you too appreciate the wonders of the mountain! Show me how they speak to you!
en: Ho, traveler! I see you too appreciate the wonders of the mountain! Show me how they speak to you!
ja: おお　旅の人よ! あなたも　この山の　不思議さが　わかるようだな! その声が　どう　届いているか　見せてくれ!

key: You hear their voice loud and clear! Very good!
en: You hear their voice loud and clear! Very good!
ja: その声を　はっきりと　聞き取っているな! すばらしい!

key: Go on, traveler! Answer the mountain's call!
en: Go on, traveler! Answer the mountain's call!
ja: さあ　旅の人よ! 山の呼び声に　こたえるのだ!
